name: Fart Hotel
summary: Fart Hotel is a mobile game made by Scott Cawthon in 2014. Someone cut the cheese and you have twelve suspects! In this puzzle game, watch everyone's faces closely for facial ticks, dripping sweat, or the uncontrollable grin of guilt! Tap on their face as soon as you think you know who did it! Guessing wrong will deduct from your time and guessing right will add to it! The time counts begins to count faster as each round passes!
